description: A list maximum follows pushes and pops
code:
temps = [18, 24, 9]
high = temps.max()
temps.push(30)
assert(high, 30)
temps.pop()
high

description: A selector finds the lowest property over every instance of a class
code:
class Offer(price):
    this.price = price
Offer(40)
Offer(25)
cheapest = Offer.min(offer -> offer.price)
Offer(10)
cheapest

description: The extremes of an empty list or class equal Math.max() and Math.min()
code:
class Bid
pending = []
[pending.max() == Math.max(), Bid.min(bid -> bid.amount) == Math.min(), String(pending.max())]

description: Extremes compare values as numbers so numeric strings and booleans convert
A class-level rule keeps the highest reading of each room
code:
class Room(name):
    this.name = name
class Sensor(room, temp):
    this.room = room
    this.temp = temp
$Room.high = Sensor.filter(sensor -> sensor.room == $Room).max(sensor -> sensor.temp)
lab = Room("lab")
Sensor(lab, 21)
Sensor(lab, 25)
lab.high

description: A filtered minimum covers only the matching items and stays live
code:
bids = [120, 90, 150, 60]
serious = bids.filter(amount -> amount >= 100).min()
bids.push(105)
serious

description: A missing property keeps a population maximum unknown until it is set
code:
class Item
pen = Item()
pen.price = 3
book = Item()
priciest = Item.max(item -> item.price)
assert(priciest, null)
book.price = 12
priciest

description: A max selector that is not a function raises a TypeError
code:
failure = ""
try:
    [1, 2].max(5)
catch error:
    failure = error
failure
